shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rough stone surface
curvilinear/schematic incised motif of indeterminate subject
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving with rounded, schematic outlines on undressed stone, and in each case a curvilinear motif sits on a broad flat face, but that is a generic correspondence. B shows a clearly organised, stacked scheme of registers with recognisable animal figures (birds/quadruped, a vertical serpentine element) and a shaped anthropomorphic pillar with an arm, whereas A shows only a single indistinct swirling motif on a boulder with no legible figures, relationships or registers.
